application_conditions: Bloggers, influencers, publishers and content creators with a qualifying website, trading software and/or mobile app, or Bybit customers with an extensive trader network; free, "subject to approval by the Bybit team"; apply at affiliates.bybit.com.
paid_action: Share of trading-fee profit (fees − maker rebates − bonuses) from referred users who actively trade.
validation_conditions: Referred users receiving rebates, discounts or incentives under another Bybit programme may not generate commission; relationship "may be terminated" after 180 consecutive days without trades, after which no further rebates are paid; Affiliate ID cannot be deleted.

commission.model_note: Share of trading-fee profit (fees − market-maker rebates − bonuses/coupons), maker and taker volume both count, "perpetual"/lifetime, no referral limit. No standard base rate published (set per affiliate and client tier). VIP accounts: total rebate capped at 50%, Master-affiliate override 10% of the sub-affiliate rebate within that cap (worked example: $100 VIP fees, 40% sub rate → $40 + $4 Master); non-VIP accounts: no overall cap. Card not mentioned.

payout.method: Affiliate Portal → Withdraw → linked Bybit trading account → standard on-chain withdrawal to an external wallet
